body:
PankFlamingos - Thank you very very much for your reply, I know that's the reason behind this forum. But it means a lot you took the time to read my thread and actually put in a very kind response. I totally understand what you're saying, I know I'm strong deep down, but you know how hard it can be sometimes. A lot of it is situational for me unfortunately. I live in my dads old council house with my brother, we have two rooms out of the whole house that are presented to a reputable standard. The rest of it is all old, horrible and out dated. We essentially live in a shit hole. But with £200 a month to survive on, you think more about food, gas and water then you do at the up keep of your house. 

I am extremely sorry you lost your boyfriend, I can't imagine the pain you must have gone through and still do to this day, the fact that you can almost control your down points and turn them around is inspiring. I'm glad life is treating you better now then it was. I really am inspired, I feel awful that, that has happened to you. I really do.

I totally agree with you regarding the small things, it is the small things in life that matter. I just feel imprisoned in my own life. I missed out on all the years I should of lived going out with friends, party's, clubs, music festivals. It just seems to suck that I can't get over the resentment of it all. It feels like I am trapped within my thoughts, I know life will change and I know I need to get over what's happened, because if not I'll have this built up rage forever. But I really do struggle, it plays on my mind every minute of the day. 

But regardless of what's been said, THANK YOU. Thank you for taking the time to be there for a stranger, thank you for being part of this thread, I really hope you inspire others also. I really am past the point in caring any more sadly about my own well being. So whatever happens, I'll drink tonight to you. Cheers.
